versions.content: Provide the current status of each warning indicator. Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall derive the current warning indicator status from the assigned events according to ISO 14229-1. The warningIndicatorRequested bit shall be set according to ISO 14229-1. Rationale: The warning indicator status is used to activate or deactivate indicators like lamps, text message or a beep. The state is calculated in diagnostic in AUTOSAR wherefore the information needs to be distribution to the application. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – ▽ △ Use Case: Indications of certain malfunctions to the driver (e.g. Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL)).
